item: Application for a Temporary Resident Visa (IMM 5257) and Family Information (IMM 5645)
Letter of invitation from the child or grandchild: promise of financial support, the household list with names and dates of birth, signed
Proof of the host's income: Notice of Assessment (or T4/T1, pay stubs, employer letter, bank statements)
note: Either of the 2 tax years, or 75% plus the visitor's income

item: Proof of medical insurance: Canadian or OSFI-authorized insurer, $100,000, 1 year from entry, paid (not a quote)
Proof of the immigration medical exam
Proof the host is a citizen, PR or registered Indian (and the co-signer, if any)
Proof of the relationship to the host (birth certificates)
Translations of documents not in English or French
condition: any document not in English or French
